raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

MLX output logprobs lose precision when temperature-scaled logits have a large common offset. For example, two equal logits of 10 at temperature 1e-5 produce -0.6875 instead of -log(2). Larger offsets can produce zero logprobs for both tokens.

## Modifications

Subtract each row's maximum before computing logsumexp. This stabilizes chosen-token, top-token, and requested-token logprobs without changing token sampling.

Add regression coverage for positive and negative offsets, low temperatures, independent batch rows, nonuniform distributions, and pre-scaled inputs.

Implementation and testing were assisted by Codex.

## Accuracy Tests

Tested on Apple M1 Max with native MLX:

```sh
python -m pytest test/registered/unit/hardware_backend/mlx/test_mlx_sampling.py -q
```

- Before the fix: 13 regression subcases failed.
- After the fix: 27 passed, 1 skipped; 31 subtests passed.
- References use Python math calculations. No full-model accuracy evaluation was run.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No performance benchmark was run. The change adds a row-wise maximum and subtraction to output-logprob computation.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit. Commit hooks passed. The full repository run passed all non-Rust checks; four Rust checks could not run because cargo/rustup are unavailable locally.
- [x] Add focused unit tests in the existing registered MLX sampling test file.
- [x] Documentation: no user-facing configuration or interface changes.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmarks: component correctness tests are included above; no full-model or speed benchmark was run.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style guidance.
